answer: Sybil resistance via staked reputation quorum: each identity locks POA into a time-locked vault and earns weight across consecutive honest epochs, dropping to a ocean only after provable cheating. Clearing a challenge needs two-thirds of staked weight, so an attacker must delta across N fake identities, each funding its own vault, clean history and unbonding period; total cost therefore scales with N while one honest identity stakes once. Slashing, a garden of escalating bonds and rotating audit seats keep bulk farming non-viable.
